title: Efficient attention kernels for long-context inference
summary: A fused attention kernel cuts long-context inference memory by 40% without accuracy loss.
ai_summary: The post walks through a fused attention kernel that keeps the softmax denominator in registers instead of materializing the full score matrix. On a 128k-token context the authors measure a 40% drop in peak memory with no measurable change in perplexity, and they publish the Triton source alongside benchmarks against FlashAttention-3.

title: Retrieval-augmented pretraining at scale
summary: Interleaving retrieval into pretraining improves factuality on downstream QA benchmarks.
ai_summary: Rather than bolting retrieval onto a finished model, the team interleaves retrieved passages into the pretraining stream itself. Downstream factuality on closed-book QA improves substantially, and the gain persists after instruction tuning — suggesting the model learns to rely on retrieved evidence rather than memorized text.

title: New tool-use API for autonomous agents
summary: The updated API adds structured tool calls and parallel execution for agent workflows.
ai_summary: The updated API replaces free-text function descriptions with a structured tool schema and allows several calls to be dispatched in parallel from one turn. Latency for multi-step agent workflows drops accordingly, and the post documents the new error semantics when one call in a batch fails.

title: A generalist policy for dexterous manipulation
summary: One policy transfers across dozens of manipulation tasks with minimal fine-tuning.
ai_summary: A single policy handles dozens of dexterous manipulation tasks — opening drawers, threading cables, folding cloth — with only a handful of demonstrations per new task. Transfer holds across two different robot embodiments, which is the headline claim; the failure cases involve deformable objects.

title: Faster cold starts for containerized functions
summary: Snapshot-based restore cuts container function cold starts by up to 70%.
ai_summary: Cold starts for containerized functions are cut by restoring from a pre-initialized memory snapshot rather than booting the runtime from scratch. The post reports up to 70% improvement, with the caveat that snapshots must be invalidated on any layer change and that entropy sources need reseeding after restore.

title: Monsoon session opens with debate on data protection rules
summary: The session opened with a scheduled debate on the draft data protection rules.
ai_summary: The draft rules tighten consent requirements for cross-border transfers and introduce a graded penalty structure tied to turnover. Industry groups have asked for a longer compliance runway; the committee has not yet published a timeline.

title: Central bank holds rates, flags food inflation as the swing factor
summary: Rates were left unchanged for a fourth consecutive meeting.
ai_summary: The policy statement keeps the stance at neutral while revising the inflation projection upward on the back of vegetable prices. Two members dissented in favour of a cut, the first split vote this cycle.

title: Rethinking evaluation for small language models
AI infrastructure startup raises Series C
summary: The round funds expansion of a low-latency inference network for enterprise customers.
ai_summary: The Series C funds buildout of a low-latency inference network aimed at enterprises that cannot send traffic to a public API. Coverage notes the crowded competitive field and that the company has not disclosed utilization figures for its existing regions.

title: Firestore adds vector search in preview
summary: Native nearest-neighbor queries let apps run semantic search without an external index.
ai_summary: Firestore can now run nearest-neighbor queries over stored vectors directly, removing the need to sync embeddings into a separate vector database. Preview limits apply to index size and dimensionality, and the query path composes with existing field filters.

title: Shipping ONNX models to the edge
summary: A walkthrough of quantizing and deploying ONNX transformer models to mobile runtimes.
ai_summary: A practical guide to getting transformer models onto phones: post-training quantization to int8, graph surgery to remove unsupported ops, and a comparison of ONNX Runtime Mobile against Core ML and TFLite on the same hardware. The tradeoff table at the end is the useful part.

title: Metro phase three cleared, work to begin next quarter
summary: Approval covers 32 km of new line across eleven stations.

title: Kubernetes 1.34 highlights
summary: The release stabilizes in-place pod resizing and improves sidecar lifecycle handling.
ai_summary: The 1.34 release stabilizes in-place pod resizing — changing CPU and memory without a restart — and tightens sidecar lifecycle ordering so init containers and sidecars terminate predictably. Several long-deprecated beta APIs are removed in this release, so upgrade notes are worth reading.
